name: Builds
author: Brett
description: One Builds page over the one builds store (builds@1, owned by the Build orchestrator): every build of the active build profile, with switchable views. Builds = one row per build with a live progress bar, status, steps, time left; double-tap or right-click a name to rename it (the id never changes). Steps = every atomic step as its own stored record, for one build or the whole profile: expandable rows, multi-select (Ctrl+click, long-press, optional checkboxes), drag to reorder steps and builds, divide a step, harvest selected steps into one new build or split them into N, Restore default. Everything in the Steps view is a draft (saved, survives a restart) until Apply; Discard drops it. Live progress bars per build, per step and per profile; the banner shows the profile's percentage, animated while a build runs. Runs in AmberX too (its server forwards the routes).

items.title: Apply page ops
items.description: Apply the page's immediate ops at once: rename-build, rename-step, reorder-builds, reorder-steps, step-done, set-status, hide, unhide, archive, delete, note. Model-switch approvals are not ops here (the orchestrator holds upgrades for Brett).
